name: Comfortable-Pace Walking

instructions.description: Stand tall and begin walking at a comfortable pace.
Let the arms swing naturally and place each foot smoothly.
Adjust pace so breathing remains manageable.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record distance completed while maintaining the intended movement quality.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Brisk Walking Intervals meaningfully changes the difficulty, loading, support, or movement demands compared with Comfortable-Pace Walking.
Comfortable-Pace Walking — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Choose a clear, even route or indoor space.
